## MPC TOOLS 1.5.8

- **Remote presses the MPC's real buttons.** Play, Stop and Rec no longer use MMC, so they work without any MIDI settings on the MPC (MMC is still the fallback). This fixes the transport buttons doing nothing when Receive MMC was off.
- **Lots more controls on the Remote tab:** Play Start, Overdub, Shift, Menu, Main, Browse, Undo, Copy, Tap Tempo, Q-Link, the data wheel (left/right ×1 and ×5, push), Minus, Plus, Erase, Step Seq, Track Mute, Next Seq, Sample Edit, Prog Edit, Full Level, 16 Level, Note Repeat and pad banks A–D.
- **One-tap Shift:** tap Shift, then the next button (or a tap on the screen) gets Shift with it.
- New keys: `O` overdub, `M` menu, `←` `→` data wheel (Shift+arrow = ×5).
- On an MPC One the button list is set up by itself the first time the Remote tab opens.

## Downloads

- **Windows:** `MPC-TOOLS-1.5.8-windows-x64.exe`
- **Mac:** `MPC-TOOLS-1.5.8-mac.zip` (not yet tested on a real Mac. On first open use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway)
- `SHA256SUMS` to check the files
